title: Markov bound for a finite distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $p$, and let $Y:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be nonnegative at every point. For every $a>0$, the probability that $Y\ge a$ is at most $\mathbb E_p[Y]/a$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
